description: This file defines the ViewRelationships class, which manages the display logic for module relationship views within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder. It includes methods for rendering relationship data, handling different contexts (deployed vs undeployed modules), and fetching related templates.

classes.name: ViewRelationships
classes.description: Handles rendering of module relationship views in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder, including AJAX data preparation, UI section assembly, and template fetching.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module view, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to generate and output the relationships view, handling both deployed and undeployed module contexts.

methods.name: getAjaxRelationships
methods.description: Processes relationships into a JSON-serializable array with translated labels for display.

methods.name: fetchTemplate
methods.description: Overrides base method to fetch templates, with support for custom file paths.
